During the sales horizon, no restocking is allowed. Demand quantities for ‘Baby’ products are specified in the ‘Demand’ column and are assumed to be deterministic and known in advance. The decision variables x_i represent the number of units of each ‘Baby’ product i that the retailer plans to fulfill.
